text: During the frigid winter of 1979, four elderly friends in the New England town of Milburn meet as the Chowder Society to share tales of horror. After Mayor Edward Wanderley and his son David both fall to their deaths, his other son Don tells of [a lover named Alma who was as cold as a corpse|rules|it wears a familiar face]. An old photograph shows a woman identical to Alma, and [the surviving friends|who_suffers|the guilty punished] are pulled back to [a night in 1929|wrong|an accident and its guilt], a young woman named Eva Galli, and [a car sinking into a pond|images|water and drowning].
